items.question: I already sent Rs 45,000 today. Can I now send Rs 55,000 to one person in a single UPI payment?
items.reference_answer: Your daily remaining limit is Rs 55,000 because Rs 1,00,000 - Rs 45,000 = Rs 55,000. But one transaction can be only up to Rs 50,000, so you cannot send Rs 55,000 in a single payment. Split it within the daily limit.

items.question: Today I have made 17 successful payments on PayLoom. How many more successful UPI payments can I do before midnight?
items.reference_answer: You can make up to 20 successful transactions per day. 20 - 17 = 3, so you have 3 successful transactions left before midnight.

items.question: Naya bank account add kiye 10 hours hue hain. I already sent Rs 3,200 today and want to send Rs 2,500 more. Allowed hai kya?
items.reference_answer: No. In the first 24 hours after adding a bank account, the limit is Rs 5,000 per day. You have Rs 5,000 - Rs 3,200 = Rs 1,800 left, so Rs 2,500 is above the limit.

items.question: My basic wallet balance is Rs 7,600. What is the maximum I can add right now without upgrading KYC?
items.reference_answer: A basic wallet can hold up to Rs 10,000. Rs 10,000 - Rs 7,600 = Rs 2,400, so you can add up to Rs 2,400.

items.question: I have full KYC wallet with Rs 1,85,000 balance. Can I add Rs 20,000 more?
items.reference_answer: No. A full KYC wallet can hold up to Rs 2,00,000. You can add only Rs 2,00,000 - Rs 1,85,000 = Rs 15,000.

items.question: If I add Rs 3,500 to wallet using my credit card, kitna fee lagega?
items.reference_answer: Adding money with a credit card has a 2 percent fee. 2 percent of Rs 3,500 is Rs 70, so the fee is Rs 70.

items.question: I paid 4 electricity bills from wallet. What total convenience fee will PayLoom charge?
items.reference_answer: Wallet bill payments add a convenience fee of Rs 3 per bill. 4 x Rs 3 = Rs 12 total fee.

items.question: I did mobile recharges of Rs 99, Rs 150 and Rs 249. What platform fee total should I expect?
items.reference_answer: Recharges up to Rs 100 are free, so Rs 99 has no fee. The Rs 150 and Rs 249 recharges are above Rs 100, so each has Rs 2 fee. Total fee is Rs 4.

items.question: I have already got rewards for 8 referrals this calendar month. If 5 more friends complete eligible first payments, how many of those can give me rewards and how much will I earn?
items.reference_answer: You can earn rewards for up to 10 referrals per calendar month. 10 - 8 = 2 more referrals can give rewards. You earn 2 x Rs 100 = Rs 200.

items.question: My friend joined from my referral and made first payment of Rs 90 within 30 days. Do we get Rs 100 each?
items.reference_answer: No. The first payment must be at least Rs 100. Rs 90 is Rs 10 short, so the referral reward condition is not met.

items.question: I got a scratch card 12 days ago but forgot to open it. How many days are left before it expires?
items.reference_answer: A scratch card expires 15 days after you receive it. 15 - 12 = 3 days are left.

items.question: Cashback for my payment is not in wallet yet. It has been 36 hours. How much longer can it take as per policy?
items.reference_answer: Cashback is credited within 48 hours of the payment. 48 - 36 = 12 hours may still be left.

items.question: I want one transaction statement covering 18 months. Is that possible in one download?
items.reference_answer: No. A statement download can cover up to 12 months. 18 months is 6 months more than the allowed period.

items.question: I am looking for a payment from 30 months ago in app history. Should it be visible?
items.reference_answer: No. The app shows the last 24 months of transactions. A 30-month-old payment is 6 months older than that limit.

items.question: Merchant approved my refund 9 working days back and I still did not get it. Am I eligible to raise a dispute now?
items.reference_answer: Yes. You should raise a dispute if more than 7 working days have passed since merchant approval. 9 working days is 2 working days over that limit.

items.question: A merchant charged me twice for the same order, and it has been 2 working days. Should I raise a dispute already?
items.reference_answer: Not yet. A duplicate charge is normally reversed within 3 working days. Since only 2 working days have passed, wait 1 more working day.

items.question: My UPI payment failed and money was deducted. It has been 4 working days and no reversal. What now?
items.reference_answer: A failed payment is reversed automatically within 3 working days. Since 4 working days have passed, raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the transaction ID.

items.question: Payment pending hai aur amount deduct ho gaya. 26 hours ho gaye. Kya wait karu ya dispute karu?
items.reference_answer: A pending payment is completed or reversed within 24 hours. Since 26 hours have passed, it is 2 hours over the limit. Raise a dispute in Help > Payments.

items.question: I sent money to the wrong person 5 days ago. How many days are left to file the Wrong Transfer complaint within PayLoom policy?
items.reference_answer: You must raise a Wrong Transfer complaint within 7 days. 7 - 5 = 2 days are left. Also contact your bank.

items.question: It is 12 April and I need the annual statement for tax filing. How many days until PayLoom says it will be available?
items.reference_answer: The annual statement is available from 15 April. From 12 April to 15 April is 3 days.
